_note: Our own data. Each pilot's own stash and money (per-player wallets with the tracked-wallet house rule), the squad fund for shared things, and food and water (the food-and-water house rule). A ration is a sealed field pack, MRE-style: a full day's food and water in one, keeps indefinitely, packs small, so it sells for more than its parts. The book tracks none of this (Core p.10); all of it is the user's house rules, off by default.

food.name: Food
food.text: A day's food, fresh or tinned. It can spoil if you keep it too long.

water.name: Water
water.text: A day's water in a sealed flask.

ration.name: Field ration
ration.text: A sealed field pack, MRE-style: a full day's food and water in one. Keeps indefinitely and packs small.

repair_kit.name: Repair kit
repair_kit.text: Tools and spares to patch up between fights.

lines.starving: {name} hasn't eaten in days: they're weak and short-tempered.
lines.dehydrated: {name} is badly dehydrated: dizzy, headaches, slurring words.

need_mods._note: What cuts a pilot's daily food and water need (fractions, they stack; never below the floor of a quarter a day). Implants come from the cybernetics clinic under the Cybernetic upgrades house rule.
